x: Following JB into the film business is Kevin Sturman. We can't say too much at present but there is a connection with Sean Connery and Greece.
KEVIN STURMAN.D.o.b. 11.12.62. Coached by Mick Dunphy.Kevin was tempted to join the US Univ. circuit some 2 years ago and only returned to the UK this summer when he joined Belgrave.
We also saw Kevin Sturman in Belgrave colours for the first time and nobody would have guessed from his styllish run that this was also to be his first race since injury in the summer.

Kevin Sturman spent 3 weeks before Xmas out in Greece selected as a mobile 'Look alike' for star Jason Connery, son of you know who! This film is an epic entitled 'The first Olympics' and Virginia McKenna, Bill Travers and Benedict Taylor are the stars .

Having Gary Staines up front on three occasions and Stuart Paton well placed twice plus a fine debut run by Kevin Sturman in the last race provided a most welcome boost to the rest of the team making every place gained that much more valuable.
Back row left to right; Mike Alleyne, Derrick Williams, Guy Sagar, Pat Lyttle, Dave Mote, Gary Staines, John Gladwin, Kevin Sturman, Richard Addison, and Mark Sinclair.
Dave North was first man hoem in 16th place with Kevin Sturman in 22nd position. New member Marcus Clarke ran as a guest and finished just ahead of Dave North.
In the Senior event Kevin Sturman had a blinder in 63rd place and Dave North put his Southern run behind him to beat some good men in 157th position.

By the time he handed over to Gary Staines on the next 1200m leg we were 9secs. clear and Gary, followed by Kevin Sturman(1100m) - Paul Richley(800m) - Richard Addison(400m) - Guy Sagar(400m) - and Derrick Williams(200m) each maintained that margin as the strolled round lapping up the multi-lingual…
With Kevin Sturman looking doubtful for the 12 stage due to injury interest centered on whether Chris Steer or Ed Bojtler would make the last short leg.

Only Kevin Sturman and John Bicourt were unavailable and our youngest ever team(with the exception of 'Super Lol') did all that we had hoped for running 8 minutes faster than last year, qualifying for the National 12 stage, and producing a time that would have been good enough for 2nd place 4 years ago.
Training at the Belgrave Hall bar proved invaluable as John downed 7 lagers before obliging!! Kevin Sturman and Paul Richley departed our shores mid-summer for life at U.S.
Doesn't qualify for the International Honours Board though! Remember Paul Richley and Kevin Sturman left our shores for U.S.

Kevin Sturman travelled back to the U.K. with his charming wife Anita for a lengthy holiday this summer and raced for the Club whenever possible setting seasons bests of 14.23.13 for the 5000m and 29:48.2 for the 10,000m.
Marcello Bizio winner of the Spring 5¾ race and Kevin Sturman winner of the Autumn race.
